basic_profile.bio: I'm a home cook from New Orleans with a passion for authentic Creole and Cajun cuisine. I spend a lot of my free time experimenting in the kitchen and sharing my culinary experiences online. Besides cooking, I'm a huge fan of sharp-tongued humor and enjoy listening to comedic podcasts like The Dick Show. I'm currently living in Placerville, working as a freelance graphic designer. My online activity usually peaks in the evenings after work, and I'm happily single, which gives me plenty of time to dive into my culinary pursuits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a strong background in cooking, having learned the art of Creole and Cajun cuisine from my grandmother. Over time, I've expanded my culinary knowledge through online cooking courses and countless hours of self-experimentation in the kitchen.
